name: Mud
description: Slow going on foot. Jumps are normal.
_help: runScale: your speed on the ground (platformer, brawler); in the air you move at normal speed, so jumps are as high and as long as usual. shipScale: your ship (shmup), kept higher than runScale so every shmup stays dodgeable (npm run check:shmup checks this). Racer: runScale is your speed on the ground; in the air you keep normal speed, so jumps are as long as usual. Rivals never ride faster than you can, so you always catch them. Enemies are not slowed. levels: settings for level 2 and 3, picked at the machine.
